mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may reduce coenzyme Q10 levels through inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase pathway, potentially reducing the antioxidant and cardioprotective effects of CoQ10.
action: Monitor patients on chronic hydrochlorothiazide therapy for symptoms of statin-like myopathy; consider CoQ10 supplementation (100-200 mg daily) in patients with heart failure or reduced ejection fraction.
